nodes.label: Asset Inventory
nodes.rationale: Received and inventoried: 24 book covers, 6 pieces of show key art, 5 network logos, 4 bestseller badges, 3 logo lockups (TV / BOOKS / BRAND DEVELOPMENT), the MAJOR TV logo animation (5.4s), the Uncontained intro recording (19.1s), copy doc, trailers doc.

nodes.label: Company Story (Publisher & Producer Under One Roof)
nodes.source_location: ## What's true in every variation — The story
nodes.rationale: Culturally inspired, not culturally exclusive. TV | FILM | BOOKS.
nodes.norm_label: company story (publisher & producer under one roof)

nodes.label: Word-Flow Intro Animation
nodes.source_location: ## What's true in every variation — The intro animation
nodes.rationale: Scripted precisely by RG's copy doc with pacing taken from the Uncontained recording: full-screen lines fade in and out in sequence, resolving into a slowed MAJOR logo build (wings, M, letters spread, descriptor), then holding on the lockup. Plays once, no loop.

nodes.label: MAJOR TV to MAJOR CONTENT Rebrand
nodes.source_location: ## What's true in every variation — The rebrand
nodes.rationale: CONTENT is set in the matched thin tracked-caps face rather than assembled from existing lockup art because no letter C exists in any current descriptor lockup; the new lockup is centered edge-to-edge under MAJOR per RG's instruction. Clean traced SVG paths of the MAJOR wordmark from the previous build make the new lockup straightforward.
nodes.norm_label: major tv to major content rebrand

nodes.label: 24-Project Wall
nodes.source_location: ## What's true in every variation — The projects wall
nodes.rationale: Shows and books interleaved in ONE grid per RG's framing 'impressive as a sum'. Every tile carries its proof line using the badge art he sent; the four show tiles link to trailers, books stay static. No case pages, no per-project deep-dives — the wall itself is the argument.

nodes.label: Open Questions for RG
nodes.rationale: Nine open items gating execution: raw logo animation file, fate of BRAND DEVELOPMENT, montage-reel footage rights, a hostable Vegas Residency trailer file, the new contact email, DRIVE's exact Emmy citation, a current founder photo, GoDaddy access for domain pointing and the 301, and the new footer office wording.

nodes.label: RadicalMedia (Benchmark Site)
nodes.rationale: Source of the poster-frame-renders-instantly, video-crossfades-in-when-ready hero mechanic; RG's stated favorite reference.

nodes.label: RG (Client / Founder)
nodes.rationale: Source of the brief, the asset drop, the copy doc, and both reference videos; his four-act arc is REG, Rayo, Celebra, MAJOR. All three variations stage only the content he sent.

nodes.label: Traced SVG MAJOR Wordmark
nodes.source_location: ## What's true in every variation — The rebrand; closing assets note
nodes.rationale: Clean traced SVG paths of the MAJOR wordmark from the previous build, preserved in archive/public/brand/ along with brand color extraction; reused for the new lockup and the live web intro animation.

nodes.label: Transient (Benchmark Site)
nodes.rationale: Lends the discipline of the founder section: not a resume timeline but a told story, ending on the People en Espanol recognition as a pull-quote.

nodes.label: Uncontained Media (Benchmark Site)
nodes.source_location: ## Variation 3 — THE MANIFESTO; intro animation teardown
nodes.rationale: Source of the intro pacing RG loves and of the continuous marquee-strip wall idea; its baked-MP4 intro is the cautionary lesson. uncontainedmedia.com is now offline (domain does not resolve), making the look unclaimed territory.

nodes.label: Variation 1 — THE REEL
nodes.rationale: RadicalMedia DNA: the work is the hero — no headline, a fast-cut montage with the logo animation over it; the credits do the talking. Closest match to RG's ask ('trailers and book images quickly flash behind animation') and his stated favorite reference. Trade-off: demands a well-cut 20-40s montage reel (an editing task) plus trailer footage rights, and books risk reading as guests in a TV company's house unless cover beats get real weight. Strict monochrome chrome so key art and jackets supply all the color.

nodes.label: Variation 2 — THE MARQUEE
nodes.rationale: Fifth Season DNA: a premium-studio full-screen rotating marquee where an Emmy-winning show and a #1 NYT bestseller alternate as equals. Most 'big studio' of the three and best home for a growing slate (coming-soon tiles slot in; structure scales for years). Trade-off: heaviest build (carousel system, three rails, per-vertical pages) and with 4 shows + 20 books it must be art-directed carefully so it doesn't feel like a jacket stretched over a smaller frame. Dark cinematic base with one warm accent ramp splitting screen vs page.

nodes.label: Variation 3 — THE MANIFESTO
nodes.rationale: Uncontained lineage x Transient discipline: the word-flow intro IS the site — one black cinematic page reading culture, content, proof, founder, built verbatim from RG's copy doc structure. Purest expression of RG's own copy; since uncontainedmedia.com is offline, the look is unclaimed territory. Fastest to launch (no CMS, no case pages). Trade-off: one page means one story — no per-project depth or rails to grow into; if the slate doubles it becomes the brochure preceding Variation 2.

nodes.label: RG's Copy Doc
nodes.source_location: Preamble; intro animation; projects wall; Variation 3
nodes.rationale: Scripts the intro word-flow sequence precisely, supplies all 24 project tiles with proof lines, and already carries the culture-content-proof-founder structure that Variation 3 builds verbatim.

nodes.label: Hybrid Launch Path
nodes.rationale: The three variations aren't mutually exclusive — a real path is to launch Variation 3's intro plus Variation 1's wall now, and grow into Variation 2's structure as the slate expands. Worth putting in front of RG as an option.

nodes.label: Live Text + Animated SVG Intro Mechanism
nodes.source_location: ## What's true in every variation — The intro animation (Uncontained teardown lesson)
nodes.rationale: Uncontained baked their intro into a 1080p MP4 — heavy, blurry at odd sizes, invisible to Google, unskippable. Building the intro as live text plus the animated SVG wordmark instead is crisp at every size, a few KB, real indexable copy, skippable on scroll, and degrades gracefully for reduced-motion users. The raw After Effects file is not needed but would let the metallic shading of the M be matched exactly.
nodes.norm_label: live text + animated svg intro mechanism
